# 2026 Creative Arts Emmy Awards – See the list of winners

The Creative Arts Emmy Awards, the two-night event celebrating TV talent on and offscreen, have begun turning nominees into winners.

"John Candy: I Like Me" director Colin Hanks, "Dancing with the Stars" host Julianne Hough, "The Upshaws" star Wanda Sykes and "Big Brother" host Julie Chen Moonves hosted the first of two nights at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on Saturday, Sept. 5. [...] Mariska Hargitay, winner of the outstanding documentary or nonfiction special award for "My Mom Jayne: A Film By Mariska Hargitay," poses during night one of the Creative Arts Emmy Awards at Peacock Theater on Sept. 5, 2026, in Los Angeles.
